parameters.excerpt: The implementation chooses whether MBE is read-only-0 (always little-endian), read-only-1 (always big-endian), or read-write (dynamic endianness).
parameters.reasoning: The endianness control is a read-write choice for the MBE field, allowing implementations to choose between fixed or dynamic endianness.
